known_gotchas: No CI config - the toolchain above comes from packaging/ scripts and SETUP.md, not a workflow file
git add -A sweeps ~149 MB of untracked reference sources into the index. Use git add -u.
WSLg: app window may not appear (taskbar icon only). Fix with `wsl --shutdown` from Windows, not inside WSL.
A freshly installed Ubuntu has empty apt lists; run apt-get update or the DEB fails with a misleading dependency error.
Build order matters: build.sh on AlmaLinux-8 first (it produces the onedir build_deb.sh consumes), then build_deb.sh on Ubuntu.
